Subject: Your divorce by mutual consent matter - Petition No. 2792/2019

Dear Mr. Karve,

Thank you for meeting us on 20 August 2019 about your dispute with Madhuri Sandhu. As we understand it, both spouses have lived apart for a long time.

Our advice is to apply to waive the statutory cooling-off period. Please collect proof of separate residence and the consent terms and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Mrinalini Saraf
